quizQuestionWithSolutionDTO.title: Revision 1: Worst-case complexity
quizQuestionWithSolutionDTO.text: What is the worst-case time complexity of binary search on sorted input?
quizQuestionWithSolutionDTO.explanation: Each comparison halves the remaining interval.

answerOptions.explanation: The interval is halved at every step.
This describes a linear scan.
The number of comparisons increases with input size.
